products.name: BPC-157 Pen
products.shortDescription: Pre-mixed BPC-157 in a precision auto-dosing pen. Pre-set increments for repeatable laboratory measurement.
products.longDescription: BPC-157 (Body Protection Compound) is a synthetic peptide chain of 15 amino acids derived from a sequence found in human gastric juice. This research-grade preparation is supplied in a refrigerated auto-dosing pen for precise, repeatable measurement in laboratory settings. Each pen delivers up to 30 calibrated 0.25mg doses.

products.name: TB-500 Pen
products.shortDescription: Thymosin Beta-4 fragment in pre-mixed pen format. Lab-tested for sequence integrity.
products.longDescription: TB-500 is a synthetic 17–amino-acid fragment of the naturally occurring protein Thymosin Beta-4. Supplied in a temperature-stable auto-dosing pen for laboratory research applications. Each unit is shipped with a third-party HPLC purity report referenced by lot number.

specs.form: Acetate salt, pre-reconstituted in BAC water

products.name: GHK-Cu
products.shortDescription: Copper tripeptide-1 in lyophilized form. Standard research vial with rubber-sealed crimp closure.
products.longDescription: GHK-Cu is a naturally occurring copper peptide complex composed of glycine, histidine, and lysine. Lyophilized for stability and supplied in a 10mL borosilicate vial with butyl rubber stopper and crimp seal. Reconstitution instructions enclosed.

products.name: Epithalon
products.shortDescription: Tetrapeptide Epitalon, lyophilized. Each lot accompanied by third-party HPLC certification.
products.longDescription: Epithalon (Epitalon) is a synthetic tetrapeptide derived from a polypeptide found in the pineal gland. Supplied lyophilized in a sealed 5mL vial. Independent HPLC purity testing available for every lot — request the COA referenced by your lot number after delivery.

products.name: Bacteriostatic Water
products.shortDescription: 0.9% benzyl alcohol bacteriostatic water for laboratory reconstitution. 30mL multi-dose vial.
products.longDescription: Bacteriostatic Water for Injection containing 0.9% benzyl alcohol as a preservative. Used in laboratory settings for reconstitution of lyophilized peptide compounds. 30mL multi-dose vial with rubber stopper.

specs.storage: Room temperature, 28 days after first puncture

products.name: Insulin Syringes
products.shortDescription: Pack of 100 sterile single-use insulin syringes, 31G x 8mm, 1mL. Lab-grade measurement accuracy.
products.longDescription: 100 individually-packaged sterile single-use insulin syringes for accurate laboratory measurement. 31-gauge, 8mm needle length, 1mL barrel with clear markings in 1/100mL increments.
